source_grounding.source_excerpt:
Mechanism confirmed at three layers (mutable keyword map index retains keys with emptied postings; exact facet path emits zero-count hits; approximate path filters them out):
(1) lib/segment/src/index/field_index/map_index/mutable_map_index.rs:163-188 (called from struct_payload_index.rs clear_index_for_point/delete_payload/clear_payload on point deletion): 'pub fn remove_point(&mut self, idx: PointOffsetType) ... { for value in &removed_values { if let Some(vals) = self.map.get_mut(value.borrow()) { vals.remove(idx); } } ... }' — the point id is removed from the value's RoaringBitmap but the map KEY is never dropped when its bitmap becomes empty; empty-posting keys survive in self.map.
(2) lib/collection/src/shards/local_shard/facet.rs:98-154 exact_facet (chosen when request.exact=true, shard_ops.rs:521): '// Get unique values for the field' -> unique_values(...) then '// Make an exact count for each value' -> per value read_filtered(filter AND match value, DeferredBehavior::Exclude) -> 'CollectionResult::Ok(FacetValueHit { value, count })' — the hit is emitted for EVERY candidate value with NO count>0 guard, so a value whose count computes to 0 is returned as a hit.
(3) candidate enumeration: Segment::unique_values (segment/entry.rs:222) -> view.facet_values (read_view/facet.rs:135-183): no-filter branch calls for_each_visible_value(hw_counter, deferred_internal_id=None, ...) which 'When deferred_internal_id is None ... is equivalent to for_each_value' (facet_index.rs:42-69) = all map keys including empty-posting ones (mutable_map_index.rs:320-325 'for_each_value ... self.map.keys()...'). In the filter branch the candidates come from filtered points instead, which is why the log's leg C (filter region=EU) correctly omitted C (C's 50 points are all AP).
(4) contrast: the approximate face (exact=false) reaches read_view/facet.rs approximate_facet which inserts a hit only 'if count > 0' (lines 115 and 125-127) — zero-count suppression exists on the approximate face but is absent on the exact face; no code comment, docstring or test anywhere states that retaining empty map keys or emitting zero-count exact hits is intentional (by-design evidence: NONE found).
(5) FacetResponse::top_hits (data_types/facets.rs): '.k_largest(limit)' with no zero filter — zero-count hits survive when within the limit.
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST POST /collections/{c}/facet -> actix facet_api -> storage Toc -> Collection::facet (collection/facet.rs, aggregates per shard) -> LocalShard::facet (shard_ops.rs:502) -> request.exact==true -> exact_facet (local_shard/facet.rs:98) -> unique_values per segment (Segment::unique_values -> view.facet_values, read_view/facet.rs:135) [no filter -> for_each_visible_value(deferred=None) == map.keys(), includes empty-posting key 'C' left behind by MutableMapIndex::remove_point after delete_points -> clear_payload -> index.remove_point] -> per-value exact count via read_filtered(filter AND key=C, DeferredBehavior::Exclude) = 0 -> FacetValueHit{C,0} emitted (no count>0 guard, unlike approximate_facet read_view/facet.rs:115/125) -> FacetResponse::top_hits k_largest keeps it -> HTTP 200 hits [{A,175},{B,100},{C,0}]. Independent live replay (state_facet_002_comparative_probe.py, sandbox localhost:6333) reproduced [{A,2},{B,2},{C,0}] on exact=true while exact=false on the same state returned [{A,2},{B,2}] and the count face returned 4, confirming the disposition difference between the two faces and that the deletion itself was effective.
source_grounding.note: Framing note for the auditor: this is a behavioral/state candidate, not a parameter-validation one, so the outcome label maps as follows — the zero-count suppression that the approximate facet face performs ('if count > 0') and the pruning of empty-posting map keys are ABSENT on the exact face / in MutableMapIndex::remove_point respectively; that absence is the source-side fact behind the observation, and the source contains no explicit by-design declaration for the retention of empty keys or emission of zero-count hits (by_design_in_source is NOT claimed; no comments/docstrings/tests assert intent). The delete/clear path and the map-key retention are real and confirmed in code and by live replay.

mundane_explanation.surviving: Source-confirmed mechanism: after delete_points removes all points carrying value C, MutableMapIndex::remove_point empties C's posting bitmap but retains the key C in the map; with exact=true the facet path enumerates all map keys as candidates and emits a FacetValueHit for each without a zero-count guard, so the deleted value surfaces as {value:'C', count:0} — a hit whose count is factually correct but whose value no point currently carries; the same request with exact=false suppresses it. Whether the documented 'value/count hits' semantics require suppression of zero-count values is doc-silent (see contract_grounding.note and chain_trace.break_detail) — left to the auditor.
